16 Days of activism

Opening a conversation that matters.

The story

Esmah Oonf: a campaign for Huna Libya during the international 16 Days of Activism.

Client
Huna Libya
Focus
Campaigns

Created in collaboration with UNFPA Libya, the campaign addressed gender-based violence and human rights alongside the international “Color the World Orange” initiative.

Illustration, graphic design, photography, animation and video supported the conversation. The storytelling sought common ground that the audience could relate to.
